title: Find Familiar / Find Steed recast restores an absent bonded creature (S1 matrix rows 138-139)
description: After S50 (PR #599, eshyra-o9bd.19.3.4.8.22) a 'vanish-bonded' familiar/steed that drops to 0 HP stays absent with its link active, and start_encounter refuses to restore it, because presence returns only through the source recast. Implement that recast: Find Familiar cast with an active link restores presence (and may change form); Find Steed recast from absent + active link restores the same actor to maximum HP; no restoration after release/permanent dismissal; ambiguity:find-familiar-permanent-dismissal-after-zero-hp stays gated. Both spells are instantaneous, so they are modelled as ruling-sourced summoning effects; design how a recast is represented (tool or effect operation) without a universal recast system. Update start_encounter's refusal and docs/active-effect-lifecycle.md.
